summary: Two-thumb range input for choosing a low and a high bound, such as a price range, with a built-in label and supporting text.

usage.text: Set the bounds with value-start and value-end (strings, defaults 25 and 75). Both are clamped to min and max, snapped to step, and start is kept at or below end. The value property returns only valueStart.
The form receives two entries, <name>-start and <name>-end (range-start and range-end when name is unset), not one value under name.
input and change are CustomEvents with detail { valueStart, valueEnd }, not detail.value. The inner range's native input event also reaches host listeners, without detail; skip events that have none.
The required attribute has no effect on validity. Only the invalid attribute makes it invalid, showing error-text or the built-in "Please choose a valid range."
show-ticks draws marks only when (max - min) / step is from 2 to 50. With orientation="vertical" the minimum is at the bottom.

a11y.text: Each thumb is a native slider named only by label-start or label-end (default "Minimum", "Maximum"); the label attribute is in neither name. Name the quantity, e.g. label-start="Minimum price".
The thumbs cannot cross: the start thumb's announced maximum is valueEnd and the end thumb's minimum is valueStart. Arrow keys move the focused thumb by step.
